checks.claim: the dispatcher establishes the value and the method
checks.detail: X509V3_EXT_print refuses a NULL out/ext (:263-265), resolves one row (X509V3_EXT_get, :283), resolves that row's item (:296), decodes with it (:308) or that row's old-style d2i (:311-314), refuses a NULL decoded value (:317-320), and dispatches that same method pointer and value to the i2r slot (:362-364). checks.detail: See review-2 B: the item descriptor sizes, counts and offsets match OcspCrlId / OcspServiceLoc, and the d2i helpers return those types through the same item.

checks.claim: dynamic aliases cannot cross-pair a decoder and a printer
checks.detail: X509V3_EXT_add_alias copies the whole row and edits only ext_nid and ext_flags; it and i2r are copied together and the registry read hold keeps the alias live across the dispatch (B49/B51).

src/x509/v3_prn.rs:647-654. The control is crash-enforced rather than assertion-enforced: deleting the NULL refusal sends NULL into a printer that dereferences it, so the test aborts (fails) instead of passing. It is not a vacuous assertion.

bp's liveness is the exported X509V3_EXT_print caller obligation and a NULL bp is refused before dispatch; in_'s non-NULL/live/decoded-by-this-row state is established by the dispatcher; the field pointers are the decoder's own and are NULL-checked. The callback's unsafe qualification covers raw-pointer dereference at the C ABI edge, not an unstated precondition.
